nested_42day_calibration.mechanism: calibration_parts() splits dates[-42]; macro head uses predict_at(cut) with label_end < cut; inner model uses inner data with label_end < cut; zero calibration label leakage.

validation_2025H1_macro_head.mechanism: Macro cut is frozen at boundary 2025-01-01; single fixed head used across all 117 validation days; zero intra-validation learning.

macro_model_cache_integrity.mechanism: Validates exact descriptor match and model_sha256 hash match on ridge.joblib; cold starts recorded as None; raises FileExistsError on partial/corrupt caches.
